verdict.rationale: Datalab documents webhooks that send real-time notifications when document processing jobs complete, and a per-request webhook_url override, so pipelines are notified instead of blocking. The docs also refer to 'jobs' and a 'completed response', which implies async job processing, and the webhook page frames webhooks as an alternative to continuous polling. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the async submit and status-polling endpoint and its job states, and independent or hands-on corroboration of async behavior on long parses.
